snippet.title: Derby Creek - Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Derby Creek is a cozy fly fishing roguelike set on a handcrafted, pixel art creek in the Colorado Rockies. Play as an old timer with a battered tackle box, a journal full of catches, and a lifetime spent reading these waters!

Support us on Kickstarter!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ritzstudios/derby-creek

Listen to "Main Theme" on Spotify:
https://open.spotify.com/track/7Ck9C9jd4a2oCHnzaPkmMq?si=eb2b06d9abb24a9d

#flyfishing  #fishinggame #roguelike #indiegame 

Music Written and Performed by Nick Montopoli
